_comment: Sprint 37 — re-captured on GH-hosted ubuntu-22.04 after the Tier 1 migration off self-hosted Mac. Tolerance set to 100%: GH-hosted shared runners produce ±70% variance between consecutive runs on the result-grid serialise bench (1.87ms vs 3.22ms back-to-back), so 30% threshold flapped. The order-of-magnitude protection from the 100% gate is still meaningful; product perf budgets are enforced separately via per-bench target_max_ns. Refresh recipe: docs/engineering/17-benchmarks.md. Skip-gate via commit message tag bench-allow-regression: <reason>.

explain_render::explain_insights_500_nod.notes: Parse + insights walk (slowest node, highest cost, rows-removed, missing-index hints).

explain_render::explain_parse_500_nodes_.notes: 571-node real-world EXPLAIN JSON parse only. Target: render 1000 nodes <500ms (06-perf-targets §2).

parser_bench::parse_ddl_100lines.notes: 100-line DDL mix (ALTER ADD/DROP COLUMN + CREATE TABLE). Target: p95 <50ms (Sprint 20 spec).

parser_bench::parse_select_typical.notes: Typical SELECT with WHERE + ORDER BY + LIMIT. Target: p95 <10ms (Sprint 20 spec).

result_grid_format::result_grid_serializ.notes: 1k rows × 10 cols (mixed types incl. JSONB) — typical first-page payload. Target: result-grid first page <500ms (06-perf-targets §2).

100k rows — upper bound for a single page render. 1M+ rows is virtualised. Re-baselined for the Mac shell runner: observed median 22-58ms across pipelines #31-#43; 45ms covers the typical CI value, 100% tolerance soaks the remaining ±30% jitter without losing the absolute-budget gate (target_max_ns=500ms).
